title: How Shoveling Your Neighbor's Driveway Builds a Godly Man People Count On
caption:
The first real snow is coming.

Most of us clear our own driveway, maybe, and go back inside. But there's a house on your street that can't. The widow. The older guy with the bad back. The mom who leaves at 6.

Get up twenty minutes early. Do theirs first. Don't knock. Walk home.

It's not a big thing. That's the point. A man who does small, hidden work for people who can't pay him back is a man people can count on when it's big.

"Your Father who sees in secret will reward you." Matthew 6:4

Save this for the first snow. Send it to the brother on your street.
